ambiguities.detail: Pure Pages Router app (pages/_app.js + _document.js, no app/ dir). Pages Router routes are out of v0.1-alpha scope: routes[] is deliberately empty. A detector must report the pages/ boundary, never fabricate App Router routes from pages/ files.

Effective route for a URL = proxy.ts (cookie) -> next.config redirects() -> filesystem routes (useFileSystemPublicRoutes) -> rewrites.js (~105 ordered rules, first-match-wins, regex, env-gated NEW_PRICING) -> pages tree -> server/routes.js extras. The vanity-URL architecture serves the entire product URL space (/:slug) from ONE page file (collective-page.tsx) via a rewrite. Static analysis must surface layers, not collapse to fake 1:1 URL->file mappings.

package.json dev/start scripts run 'node server' / 'node dist/server' (NOT next dev/start): the app boots via a custom Express 5 server (server/index.js). A Next-only scan misses the real process entry. server/routes.js adds non-page routes (/api/download-file, /favicon.:ext, /__coverage__) + a hyphen-trim 301.
NEW_PRICING env changes /pricing destination; API_PROXY gates the /api proxy (prod uses Cloudflare workers, outside the repo). Unknown statically.

proxy.ts matcher '/' redirects to /dashboard when cookie rootRedirectDashboard is present; rewrites.js maps '/' -> '/home'. Proxy runs BEFORE rewrites — ordering subtlety for effective '/' destination.

CRITICAL: the v0.1-alpha analyzer CRASHES on this repo (exit 1): lib/graphql/types/v2/graphql.ts (29MB generated GraphQL types, file #1317 of 1644) throws 'Failed to convert rust String into napi string' inside oxc-parser's program getter; parseFile has no try/catch around parseSource so one file kills the whole run. D2 worker isolation was never implemented. The benchmark harness will hit this too. A general fix (per-file try/catch or size guard) is needed — NOT a repo-specific hack, so no STOP, but the crash is recorded here as a blocker.
